name: impacts_final
note: CMS, CY 2027 OPPS final rule (CMS-1850-FC), hospital-specific impact file. Estimated CY 2026 and CY 2027 OPPS payment per hospital, all final policies plus the 340B remedy offset. Posted 2026-11-04.

name: impacts_proposed
note: CMS, CY 2027 OPPS proposed rule (CMS-1850-P), hospital-specific impact file. Same layout as the final file. Posted 2026-07-02.

name: addenda_final
note: CMS, CY 2027 OPPS final rule addenda. Addendum R lists the providers subject to the 340B remedy offset.

name: remedy_aaa
note: CMS, 340B remedy final rule (CMS-1793-F, Nov 2023), Addendum AAA: each hospital's 340B drug payment reduction for CY 2018-2022, repaid as a lump sum.

name: opais
manual: The HRSA page builds the file in the browser: open the URL, click 'Covered Entity Daily Export (JSON)', and save the zip into data/raw/opais/.
note: HRSA 340B OPAIS covered-entity daily export (JSON), generated 2026-11-05. Only hospital parent records are kept (type, participation, start date, CCN); contact fields are dropped.

name: hcris_fy2023
note: CMS HCRIS hospital cost reports (form 2552-10), reports beginning in FY 2023. Worksheet D Part V (Medicare Part B charges) and S-2 (city, state, ZIP).
